title: CyberNest SOAR
subtitle: AI-Enhanced Security Orchestration Platform
description: Open-source SOAR platform integrating SIEM, EDR, and NDR telemetry with automated incident response workflows. Built as a team project with containerized microservices architecture.
problem: SOC teams face alert fatigue from high-volume, low-context alerts across disconnected security tools. Manual triage and response workflows slow down incident handling.
approach: Designed a modular SOAR architecture that orchestrates security tools through a centralized event-driven backend, with automated enrichment and response playbooks.
results: Core SOAR integration milestone completed with working Docker deployment of Wazuh, TheHive, Cortex, Suricata, Zeek, and Velociraptor. Backend API with 140+ endpoints across 25 categories for orchestration and enrichment.
